answer: Each submission hangs on the vertex of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the trellis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
